VI.description: Moves the mouse cursor to the SCREEN point (X\2C Y) through user32.dll SetCursorPos (stdcall\2C called in any thread). A LabVIEW menu reads the cursor position (GetCursorPos) when it handles a posted click\2C so this is how a click on an open LabVIEW popup menu is aimed. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: error in\2C or the Call Library Function Node's own error.
